purpose: Teach: ちがう/浮い/曲げ/騒い/脱い/滑り/冷やし/返せ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、それ、本気で、絶対、ちがう、絶対、お皿、絶対、よ
lines.en: Sho — don't use the wrong plate, okay? That's a serious thing.
lines.style: Firm but not unkind. Matter-of-fact instruction. Slight pause before the final point, as if making sure he's really listening. Not stern, just clear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お風呂で、本気で、絶対、浮い、絶対、てる、絶対、おもちゃ、絶対、ぼくの
lines.en: Mom — my bath toy is floating! It's really mine!
lines.style: Bright, eager to share a discovery. Quick delivery, excited emphasis on the ownership claim. Genuine six-year-old logic meeting parental attention.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お背中、本気で、絶対、曲げ、絶対、ないで姿勢よく
lines.en: Sho — sit up straight, please. Don't slouch like that.
lines.style: Gentle correction wrapped in practicality. Warm underneath the instruction. The kind of reminder that doesn't make him feel scolded.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お友達と、本気で、絶対、騒い、絶対、で遊んだよ
lines.en: Mom — I was playing with my friends and we were having so much fun!
lines.style: Quick, breathless, the words tumbling out. Pride in what he did, wanting her to understand the excitement was justified. Genuine childlike energy without self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お靴、本気で、絶対、脱い、絶対、で玄関に並べてね
lines.en: Sho — please put your shoes in a line by the door when you take them off.
lines.style: Steady, practical instruction. Patient tone. The kind of direction she gives many times because it matters, but not with frustration. Matter-of-fact expectation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お風呂場、本気で、絶対、滑り、絶対、やすいよね
lines.en: Mom — the bath floor is really slippery, isn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost conversational. Quiet observation tinged with concern. He's noticing a real hazard, and she's acknowledging it seriously despite his young age. Validating his perception.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お風邪の時は、本気で、絶対、冷やし、絶対、たタオル、絶対、おでこに、絶対、置いてね
lines.en: Sho — when you have a cold, put a cool towel on your forehead like this, okay?
lines.style: Tender instruction layered with care. Slow, deliberate pace — she's teaching him how to take care of himself. Warm, present, the voice of someone who will be the one checking if he actually did it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お友達に、本気で、絶対、返せ、絶対、ない、絶対、本、絶対、まだあるよ
lines.en: Mom — I still have that book my friend lent me. I haven't given it back yet.
lines.style: Quiet admission with a hint of sheepish awareness. He knows it's not quite right. Delivery is honest, almost confessional, the small guilty knowledge of a six-year-old who understands he's done something he shouldn't have.
